pairs.why: Nearly identical lassos, but A's rope is slightly chunkier and softer, closer to the plump smooth finish of the real cards than B's thinner, more finely twisted rope.
A's thicker, softer rope and mid-lavender ring background sit closer to the real purple card; B's rope is thinner and its background darker.
A's rope reads a little rounder and smoother, while B has a crisper, more texture-heavy twist, the direction the lessons mark as too texture-y.
Same pattern: A is slightly plumper and smoother, and B's finer strand detail makes it look a bit more texture-y than the real cards.
A's bandana is thicker and softly padded, with smooth cloth shading like the real red neckerchief; B is thinner, with a sharper tip and flatter fabric.
A has fuller, softer folds and a rounder volume closer to the plush real scarf; B is slightly flatter and more angular.
A's chunky, smoothly shaded bandana matches the soft volumetric cloth of the real cards better than B's thinner, pointier version.
A's cleaner, smoother cloth and rounded drape fit the real cards' soft finish slightly better than B's narrower, sharper-tipped bandana.
